verdict.rationale: Square's Subscriptions API supports creating recurring billing plans, which is a form of recurring job scheduling, but there is no evidence of a general-purpose workflow/task scheduler for arbitrary AI-driven automations (e.g., cron-like triggers, recurring API calls beyond billing). missing for 10: generic recurring workflow/task scheduling beyond billing, evidence of AI-agent-triggered recurring automations, cron/timer primitives outside payments domain.
